thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired for service=autoscale-controller severity=P1 -- reason: inference-queue growth > threshold (prod, region-us-east1). Pager: PD#12345

pagerduty-bot: page assigned to rotation: eng-oncall-sre (auto-ack window 2m). Escalation policy in effect.

Alice M: ack'ing — I'm on triage. first check: is this autoscaler failing to add capacity or are pods saturating? @Brian K can you grab metrics? :eyes:

Brian K: saw the spike ~5m ago. inference-queue length jumped from ~800 to ~12k. Pod cpu ~= 85%, pod replica count pinned at 10 for the last 12m. HPA attempted scale but scale-request rate shows lots of throttled requests. Provider API returns 429 on nodepool resize calls.

Carol T: logs from scale-controller show repeated errors: `error: provider API rateLimitExceeded` then `scale request dropped`. Also a few `OOMKilled` on scale-controller (recent deploy at 03:14 UTC).

Alice M: ok that matches. Immediate mitigation plan: 1) attempt manual nodepool resize to bypass autoscaler retries 2) enable routing fallback to smaller model variant to reduce per-request resource use 3) notify product/support about customer impact. I'll kick off 1.

Brian K: running manual resize now (gcloud):
```
gcloud container clusters resize redwood-prod --node-pool ig-ml-pool --num-nodes 40 --region us-east1 --quiet
```
If API still throttles we'll try the reserved-burst-pool option.

infra-bot: gcloud request accepted, operation id op-09c2. Note: provider window suggests 30-90s to provision nodes.

Alice M: toggling traffic to fallback model (model-small) for non-enterprise customers to reduce load on workers. Patch to routing service applied with weighted routing: main-model=70%, model-small=30%.

Devon R: tagging support with impact note. Customer-facing metrics: 95th latency for text-generation jumped to 2.8s (baseline ~600ms). 5xx rate up to 3% over the last 10m. Potentially customer-visible for a subset of sessions.

Carol T: scale-controller container restarted twice during the surge. Pulling recent deploy change log — there was a tuning PR that lowered provider retry backoff; looks like it made controller more aggressive and hit rate limits.

Alice M: good find. For live mitigation we should: 1) revert the recent tuning on scale-controller (quick rollback) 2) if rollback risky, patch to increase provider backoff to avoid further 429 storm 3) create a temporary manual scaling playbook so oncall can spin capacity without waiting on controller.

Brian K: nodepool resize op succeeded, new nodes are joining (kube nodes  -> 38 now). Pods are draining backlog slowly. Queue length dropping from 12k -> 6.5k in 2m. CPU on pods 70% now.

Alice M: good. I'll keep the model fallback in place for 15m and monitor. Can someone open an incident in the tracker and set status=investigating?

Devon R: opened INC-2026 in tracker and pinged support. Noting customers affected: a handful of high-traffic tenants in us-east1 experiencing elevated latencies. Tagged severity P1 and added runbook link.

pagerduty-bot: Pager acknowledged by Alice M at 1768543222. Escalation timer paused.

Carol T: preparing a quick rollback of the scale-controller image — building and will push hotfix tag. If we rollback we'll need brief restart of controller pods (should not affect existing nodes).

Alice M: agree rollback is low-risk. Proceed with hotfix. Plan for post-rollback: observe for 10m then progressively re-enable aggressive retry if safe.

Carol T: hotfix image pushed `scale-controller:hotfix-176854` and deployed to prod-sts. Rolling restart initiated.

infra-bot: rolling restart performed on 3 controller replicas, restart complete. No new OOMs observed in the last 2m. Provider call rate looks steady.

Brian K: autoscaler now issuing scale requests successfully again. Queue continues to drop: 6.5k -> 1.2k over next 6m. 95p latency moving back toward baseline. 5xx returning to ~0.2%.

Alice M: putting temporary suppression on PagerDuty for duplicate alerts on this service for next 30m. We'll leave this thread open until metrics stable and queue under 500.

Devon R: handoff note for follow-up: - root cause likely aggressive retry/backoff changes + provider API rate limits + surge in traffic. Action items: (Carol) submit PR to make backoff adaptive, (Brian) add provider-429 detection metric and alert, (Alice) update runbook to include manual nodepool resize and reserved-burst-pool steps.

Alice M: handing to next oncall in 15m if stable — @Devon R will take over if we hit regressions. If queue <500 and 95th latency <1s in 30m I'll mark resolved.

Devon R: noted. I'll monitor dashboards and coordinate postmortem. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident status updated -> monitoring (INC-2026).

Alice M: final update for thread: queue under 400, 95th latency 720ms, 5xx ~0.1%. Leaving model fallback active for another 10m then revert. Closing pager maintenance window. If anything flares re-open the thread or page SRE.

Devon R: acknowledged handoff. Adding timeline and logs to incident doc, will schedule postmortem.

Carol T: PR for adaptive backoff created: https://git.internal/r/redwood/scale-controller/pulls/231.

Alice M: closing this thread in 20m unless new alerts. Great quick ops. :sparkles:
